idea-plugin.name: N+1 Query Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Gutter icon on any Java/Kotlin for loop whose body accesses a lazy-loaded JPA association (@OneToMany/ @ManyToMany by default, or @ManyToOne/ @OneToOne with an explicit fetch = FetchType.LAZY) directly on the raw loop variable -- the classic N+1 query shape: fetch a collection, then trigger one extra query per element while iterating it.

Unlike a pure hover/visualization tool, the tooltip names the exact association and annotation responsible so the fix (an explicit JOIN FETCH/@EntityGraph, or an eager fetch where that's the right trade-off) is obvious at the exact loop that needs it.

100% static PSI analysis -- matches JPA annotations by simple name only, so it works whether the real jakarta.persistence/javax.persistence jar is on the classpath or not. Stated honestly: v0.1 only checks direct access on the raw loop variable (a variable derived from it isn't matched yet), and only classic for/for (x in y) loops, not .forEach/stream chains -- real, documented limitations, not bugs.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no network calls.
